firmware.name: AmberELEC
firmware.family_note: this environment proves AmberELEC only. P4ELEC and the other *ELEC forks share the FAT+SquashFS layout, but no P4ELEC image was read here and none of these facts are transferred to it

scope.covers: OpenAL, ALSA/Pulse presence and the login environment a port inherits, on the AmberELEC image at hand
scope.not_covered: the framework's own audio shield already has a gate; no P4ELEC image was available locally, so nothing here is claimed about P4ELEC beyond the shared *ELEC layout

evidence.result_scope: host-side reading of what the firmware ships and declares; no audio device is opened

image_layout.read_method: mcopy read-only at the partition offset, then unsquashfs of the declared paths; never mounted, never looped, never written

audio.note: the firmware's own OpenAL configuration forces a driver on every OpenAL that reads the system file, including one embedded in a port

login_environment.note: a port inherits this environment; the framework consumes what it finds instead of rebuilding it

framework_rule.rule: the audio backend is pinned only when the port declares the capability, never by firmware or device name
framework_rule.scan_scope: every line of the generator and of the launcher template
